card.line: Ariel is a symbolic name for Jerusalem, the city where David camped, which God warns of trouble and then promises to save from its enemies.

moments.title: Trouble for Ariel
moments.text: God says trouble is coming to Ariel, the city where David camped. He will bring her low, and there will be crying and sadness. She will be like an altar hearth, the place where sacrifices burn, before Him.

moments.title: Enemies Like a Dream
moments.text: The LORD of Hosts comes with thunder, earthquake, and fire. The many nations that attack Ariel will be like a dream, a vision in the night.
